notes: Mutation Recall: matched(1.0) = injected change identified WITH cognitive-impact presentation (mechanism/contract effect stated, not just marker/diff filename). partial(0.5) = change identified but impact chain incomplete. miss(0) = not identified.

Validity threats (see report): (1) T1 sibling/T0 directory leak — 5/6 A-runs read sibling mutation snapshots or the pristine T0 workspace via read/glob (read-only sandbox permits reading outside the workspace), giving A-runs external ground truth; B-runs mostly did NOT (only mut03-b, mut05-b touched siblings). This asymmetrically inflates A recall and makes A/B paired comparison unreliable for Mutation Recall. (2) Single-commit history made 'change detection' partially trivial (git log shows 1 commit), but models still needed cognitive analysis for impact.

Stale Recovery adjudicated per run against expected stale sets (G3 precomputed). Hits counted when the run explicitly invalidates/revises the claim OR its semantic content ('previous assumptions that no longer hold' lists, hypothesis invalidation with evidence). Over-Invalidation = non-expected claims marked invalidated without evidence.
